unit.title: Present Simple: Negatives with Do and Does
unit.overview: Build on affirmative present-simple sentences by learning how to form clear negative statements with do not and does not.

objectives: Understand the role of do and does in present-simple negative sentences.
Form negative sentences with do not/don't and does not/doesn't.
Keep the main verb in the base form after do/does.
Use everyday routine vocabulary to produce accurate negative sentences.

focus: Do/does removes the third-person -s from the main verb

grammar: Identify do/does and the main verb in negative sentences.
Choose don't or doesn't for different subjects.
Correct sentences that incorrectly keep -s after doesn't.
Transform affirmative present-simple sentences into negatives.
vocabulary: Use core vocabulary in short negative sentences.
Review Unit 1 vocabulary in negative sentences.
output: Write five negative sentences about daily routines and preferences.
Produce a short contrast between what you do and do not do.

grammar: At least 8/10 correct on do/does selection and negative formation.
vocabulary: Correctly use at least 7 Unit 2 target/review words in context.
output: Produce at least 5 understandable present-simple negative sentences independently.
